items.q: I thought it was Davis, if I'm not mistaken but, Davis, I know there's another one later but I think that one at that time was named Davis

You know, if Sheffield was so big that, whenever they'd rent a...they tell me now when they...he was in with all the Chinese -- the gamblers. When they arrest them for the lottery and chuckaluck-- whatever they played and everything down there--when they bring 'em into court, he always got 'em out. See?
